message.text: I'm counting up the Close() declarations — 8 total, with 6 in non-test code across Store, Cache, SSEHub, and the driver-specific DB.Close implementations dispatched through the interface, where the actual concrete driver called depends on runtime configuration.

h09.

**Count: 8 declarations (6 in production code, 2 in test helpers). Five of the six production declarations are invoked from non-test code; only the concrete driver `Close` that matches the configured database runs at runtime.**

The full set of declarations:

| Declarer | Path | Invoked by non-test code? |
|---|---|---|
| `*Store` | `store/store.go:72` | yes — `server/server.go:146` |
| `*cache.Cache` | `store/cache/cache.go:187` | yes — `store/store.go:74`, `:75`, `:76` |
| `*SSEHub` | `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:99` | yes — `server/server.go:206` |
| `*sqlite.DB` | `store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:67` | yes, via interface — `store/store.go:78` |
| `*postgres.DB` | `store/db/postgres/postgres.go:46` | yes, via interface — `store/store.go:78` |
| `*mysql.DB` | `store/db/mysql/mysql.go:47` | yes, via interface — `store/store.go:78` |
| `*MemoFilterTestContext` | `store/test/filter_helpers_test.go:200` | no — test-only |
| `*AttachmentFilterTestContext` | `store/test/filter_helpers_test.go:282` | no — test-only |

How the calls chain together: `Server.Shutdown` drives everything. It calls `closeLongLivedConnections` (`server/server.go:203-208`), which closes the SSE hub so long-lived streaming requests don't outlive `http.Server.Shutdown`, and then calls `s.Store.Close()` at line 146. `Store.Close` in turn stops the cleanup goroutines of its three caches — `instanceSettingCache`, `userCache`, `userSettingCache` — and finally calls `s.driver.Close()`, an interface call that dispatches to whichever of the three `DB` types the factory built (`store/db/db.go`). So all three driver implementations are reachable from production code, but exactly one executes in a given deployment.

Two clarifications on scope. `Store.Close` is also called from `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:66`, but that's test support code, not the server path. And I excluded calls to `Close` on standard-library values (`net.Listener`, `http.Server`, `sql.DB`, `io.ReadCloser` in `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go`, and net connections in `internal/email/client.go`) since those methods are declared outside this repository.
